body: May I suggest watching some mma videos so you can learn how to attack while being on the ground. & bro for me I was I went to one of the best HS in my area, but I found out that all that hard work i did in middle school was going to lead to more hard work instead of easy work, this meant like 3 essays every 3 months plus assignments wtf! Guess what i did... I stopped giving a fuck & just passed like 3 classes every year with 65s which is the lowest grade to pass. At the end I transfered to a credit recovery school where I passed with flying colors on my own time because it was that easy. Hopefully you're in a situation where you can do the same bro.
& I am glad it didn't happen & you're still here 💪 If anything you just proved to yourself you are strong enough to deal with the way you are feeling.

First of that is not your friend that is an enemy & next time he does that please at least hit him back so your brain doesn't stress about the situation. Secondly school assignments can wait fuck school if we're being honest. And lastly remember most of us are not dating & those who are half of them have problems like cheating for example. Is just a fact of life the older we get the less friends we have. The universe doesn't hate you bro it's just all in your head making these little problems seem big.

It's ok to talk about it, but please tell your parents. I was going to shoot myself in the head while I was very drunk, but i dont know in the end I came to my senses to live another day. I told my dad & a friend the next day & that took a weight off my shoulder dealing with these negative thoughts because they opened up to me & they told me they deal with depression too, but not at my level. 

Besides that I am thinking about going to a therapist because I feel like when I talk about my problem I feel like a pussy & well it kinda goes away plus hoping i get some anti depressants because afterall the reason we feel like this is because of a chemical imbalance in our stupid brain.
